titulo_it: Il lavoro da casa: vantaggi e limiti

texto: **Secondo alcuni** and **altri, però** present different perspectives; **tuttavia** introduces the author's proposal.
Check what conditions make the suggested solution viable.

frases.it: Secondo alcuni dipendenti, lavorare da casa riduce il tempo perso negli spostamenti e rende più semplice organizzare gli impegni familiari.
frases.es: Según algunos empleados, trabajar desde casa reduce el tiempo perdido en desplazamientos y facilita organizar los compromisos familiares.
frases.en: According to some employees, working from home reduces time spent on travel and facilitates the organization of family commitments.

frases.it: Altri, però, segnalano che la distanza rende più difficile chiedere aiuto e separare il lavoro dal tempo libero.
frases.es: Otros, sin embargo, señalan que la distancia dificulta pedir ayuda y separar el trabajo del tiempo libre.
frases.en: Others, however, point out that distance makes it difficult to ask for help and to separate work from free time.

frases.it: L'articolo non sostiene che una modalità sia sempre migliore: suggerisce di alternare giornate in ufficio e giornate a distanza.
frases.es: El artículo no sostiene que una modalidad sea siempre mejor: sugiere alternar días en la oficina y días a distancia.
frases.en: The article does not maintain that a modality is always better: it suggests alternating days in the office and days away.

frases.it: La proposta funziona, tuttavia, solo se l'azienda stabilisce obiettivi chiari e garantisce a tutti gli stessi strumenti.
frases.es: Sin embargo, la propuesta funciona solo si la empresa establece objetivos claros y garantiza a todos las mismas herramientas.
frases.en: However, the proposal works only if the company sets clear objectives and guarantees all the same tools.

frases.it: Senza queste condizioni, la flessibilità rischia di trasformarsi in isolamento.
frases.es: Sin estas condiciones, la flexibilidad corre el riesgo de convertirse en aislamiento.
frases.en: Without these conditions, flexibility risks becoming isolation.

opciones.texto: There is less time spent on displacements.
opciones.explicacion: It is one of the reasons for telework.

opciones.texto: Work is always better separated from free time.
opciones.explicacion: The text presents this as a difficulty.

opciones.texto: The company automatically guarantees the same tools.
opciones.explicacion: It is presented as a necessary condition.

bloques.pregunta: What difficulty do other employees mention?

opciones.texto: It may cost more to ask for help and to separate work and free time.
It takes longer to get to the office.
No family commitments can be organized.
opciones.explicacion: The first group considers it an advantage.

bloques.frase: L'articolo suggerisce di ___ le giornate in ufficio e quelle a distanza.

opciones.explicacion: It is the proposed intermediate solution.
The article does not propose to eliminate face-to-face work.
«Garantire» appears as a condition of the company.

bloques.pregunta: What is the position of the article?

opciones.texto: It recommends a mixed approach, subject to good organizational conditions.
opciones.explicacion: It combines benefits, limits and conditions.

opciones.texto: He claims that working at home is always better.
He concludes that telework must disappear.
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't propose to eliminate it.

opciones.texto: To clear objectives and equal tools for all.
opciones.explicacion: It is the prayer immediately before.

opciones.texto: The days in office and away.
opciones.explicacion: It is the proposal, not the conditions.

bloques.pregunta: What would happen if the conditions were not met?

opciones.explicacion: It's the risk pointed out at the end.

opciones.texto: The office day would get shorter.
opciones.explicacion: The text does not mention its duration.

opciones.texto: The employees would stop asking for help.

intro: It distinguishes the arguments of each group and the author's conclusion. The position does not fully match any of the extremes.
